newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 9.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Guinea Bissau, a former Portuguese colony in West Africa, soon to join as 15th member of Franc Zone grouping mostly former French African colonies.
- Prices of gasoil and cooking gas to go up by three percent from today.

- All eyes on Privatisation Committee which considering bids for takeover of privatised Ivorian phone company CI-TELCOM. Report published before disqualification of local consortium, Africa Bell, leaving France Telecom and Telekom Malaysia as only contenders.
- Intense battle for takeover of Ivorian telephone network: Is France Telecom favoured by authorities?
- African Development Bank approves loan of more tha $4 million for Ivorian cellular phone company Loteny Telecom SA for network expansion.
- Archives of Ivorian National Assembly to be computerised with U.S. aid.
